# MetrAIyux 0S

MetrAIyux 0S, pronounced Muh-Tray-Us, is a protected sovereign operating layer by Skyes Over London and SOLEnterprises. The website explains the system, routes visitors into command/workspace/proof/revenue lanes, and keeps private operating rooms protected.

Primary public pages:
- / — homepage
- /what-this-does/ — what the platform does
- /platform/ — platform architecture
- /command/ — command routing
- /workspaces/ — workspace paths
- /proof/ — proof and public claims posture
- /live-surfaces/ — live route directory
- /contact/ — contact and briefing path


## Dev Sauce Library
The website includes /dev-sauce/ as a public developer asset library with standalone MetrAIyux 0S SVG icons, PNG exports, copy-paste IMG snippets, reusable sx-* UI components, and /assets/metraiyux-sauce-kit.css. Icons are individual files, not a collage sheet.
